documents.text: Starting party. method. Iolo Shamino wounded, starting companions. Keep Iolo and Shamino while the party is small; heal Shamino before taking road fights.
Jaana. recruitment. free Jaana, Yew hidden jail. In Yew, enter the fireplace behind the living area, descend into the hidden jail, unlock Jaana’s cell, and ask the mage to join.
Julia. recruitment. Julia early replacement. Follow the road to Empath Abbey and recruit Julia upstairs. She is the strongest practical early replacement when the party begins to fill.
Mariah. recruitment. Gwenno recruitment, Mariah travel. Recruit Gwenno in Britain, then add Mariah at the Lycaeum once a moongate, skiff, frigate, or the Magic Carpet makes the island reachable.

Recommended party. method. six person party, Johne replacement, Shamino inn. Aim for Avatar, Iolo, Jaana, Julia, Gwenno, and Mariah. If you need space, leave Shamino at an inn; later, Johne can replace Julia for an even more magic-heavy endgame party.
Lord Michael. location. Grapple giver, Lord Michael courtyard bedroom, find the Grapple giver. Find Lord Michael at Empath Abbey: he is in the courtyard by day and retires to the northwest bedroom.
Lord Michael. method. Lord Michael GRAPPLE keyword, ask him about the Grapple, what to say to Lord Michael, Grapple giver keyword. Speak with Lord Michael and ask specifically about GRAPPLE.
Grapple. acquisition. Grappling Hook, GRAPPLE keyword, ask about the hook, dialogue topic for the Grapple. Speak with Lord Michael and ask specifically about GRAPPLE.
Grapple. use. Grappling Hook active party, keep the hook with active party. Take the Grappling Hook he provides and keep it in the active party’s inventory.

HMS Cape plans. route. Oaken Oar west entrance, Cape plans, get to the Oaken Oar shipwright, HMS Cape west entrance. Enter East Britanny and go north to the Oaken Oar shipwright’s building; use the west entrance.
HMS Cape plans. method. Oaken Oar locked doors, jimmy shipwright doors, HMS Cape room access. Move to the eastern room and jimmy both ordinary locked doors with lockpicks.
HMS Cape plans. acquisition. ship plans drawers. Search the drawers in the room until you recover the HMS Cape plans.
HMS Cape plans. use. frigate upgrade, apply plans, apply ship plans once. When you obtain a frigate, use the plans on the ship once to apply the faster sail upgrade.
HMS Cape plans. effect. double frigate speed. Using the plans on a frigate doubles its speed relative to enemies.
Castle raid kit. requirement. Skull Key reserve. Reserve at least one Skull Key for Lord British’s magically locked chamber and carry a spare in case your route changes.
Castle raid kit. requirement. fireplace preparation. Bring several lockpicks, food, direct healing, poison cure, and enough hit points to survive any fireplace passage or guard mistake.
Saduj. explanation. Blackthorn agent. Make a fresh save outside Castle Britannia. Do not recruit Saduj if he appears; he is Blackthorn’s agent and can betray the party.
Castle Britannia. route. third floor rooftop. Enter Castle Britannia and use a perimeter tower stair to climb to the third-floor and rooftop level.

Castle Britannia guard. method. guard warning, raid retreat, guard follows during raid, retreat downstairs and wait. Circle the upper perimeter until the guard moves away. If you receive a warning or the guard starts following, retreat down a stair, wait, and try again.
Lord British chamber. method. Skull Key magic door. Approach the central private suite and spend a Skull Key on Lord British’s magically locked door.

Magic Carpet. use. mountains rough sea, Carpet terrain, Carpet rough sea damage, Carpet mountain limitation. Take the Magic Carpet lying just inside the chamber. It crosses land, water, swamps, brush, and hills, but rough sea still damages the party and mountains still require the Grapple.

Sandalwood Box. acquisition. Stones harpsichord, secret wall, Sandalwood melody. Stand at the harpsichord and play Stones as 6-7-8-9-8-7-8-7-6-7-6-5-3. The secret wall opens; enter and take the Sandalwood Box.
Sandalwood Box. use. retain Box, Carpet active party. Leave by the same upper route. Keep the Carpet with the active party and retain the Box until Lord British uses it in Dungeon Doom.

Shrine pilgrimage. method. multiple pending shrine quests, Codex different virtue, multiple unfinished shrine quests, Codex resolves another virtue. With fast travel secured, complete the eight virtue loops and earn the Word of Power for Doom. Recommended: complete each Shrine → Codex → Shrine cycle before accepting another Shrine quest. Multiple shrine quests can remain pending, and the Codex may resolve a different virtue than the one you most recently visited.
Shrine of Honesty. acquisition. Honesty mantra, Honesty teacher, Honesty mantra dialogue, AHM mantra learning. Ask Malifora for the mantra. Record the mantra AHM.
Shrine of Honesty. method. Honesty meditation, Honesty three cycles, AHM three cycle meditation. Visit the Shrine of Honesty, speak the virtue name, and meditate with AHM for three cycles.

Shrine of Compassion. acquisition. Compassion mantra, Compassion teacher, Compassion mantra dialogue, MU mantra learning. Ask Greyson, affirm that British is the rightful ruler, then ask for Compassion. Record the mantra MU.
Shrine of Compassion. method. Compassion meditation, Compassion three cycles, MU three cycle meditation. Visit the Shrine of Compassion, speak the virtue name, and meditate with MU for three cycles.
Shrine of Valor. acquisition. Valor mantra, Valor teacher, Valor mantra dialogue, RA mantra learning. Follow Trian’s lead to Thorne. Record the mantra RA.
Shrine of Valor. method. Valor meditation, Valor three cycles, RA three cycle meditation. Visit the Shrine of Valor, speak the virtue name, and meditate with RA for three cycles.

Shrine of Justice. acquisition. Justice mantra, Justice teacher, Justice mantra dialogue, BEH mantra learning. Help Jeremy, use the Resistance password DAWN with Chamfort, and follow the lead. Record the mantra BEH.
Shrine of Justice. method. Justice meditation, Justice three cycles, BEH three cycle meditation. Visit the Shrine of Justice, speak the virtue name, and meditate with BEH for three cycles.
Shrine of Sacrifice. acquisition. Sacrifice mantra, Sacrifice teacher, Sacrifice mantra dialogue, CAH mantra learning. Ask Rew in Minoc. Record the mantra CAH.
Shrine of Sacrifice. method. Sacrifice meditation, Sacrifice three cycles, CAH three cycle meditation. Visit the Shrine of Sacrifice, speak the virtue name, and meditate with CAH for three cycles.
Shrine of Honor. acquisition. Honor mantra, Honor teacher, Honor mantra dialogue, SUMM mantra learning. Ask Gruman when your karma is high enough. Record the mantra SUMM.
Shrine of Honor. method. Honor meditation, Honor three cycles, SUMM three cycle meditation. Visit the Shrine of Honor, speak the virtue name, and meditate with SUMM for three cycles.

Shrine of Spirituality. acquisition. Spirituality mantra, Spirituality teacher, Spirituality mantra dialogue, OM mantra learning. In Skara Brae, ask Saul, then Kindor about SHRINE and answer yes. Record the mantra OM.

Shrine of Spirituality. method. Spirituality meditation, Spirituality three cycles, OM three cycle meditation. Visit the Shrine of Spirituality, speak the virtue name, and meditate with OM for three cycles.
Shrine of Humility. acquisition. Humility mantra, Humility teacher, Humility mantra dialogue, LUM mantra learning. Ask Shirita, then answer Wartow: BRITISH, N, N, N, Y. Record the mantra LUM.
Shrine of Humility. method. Humility meditation, Humility three cycles, LUM three cycle meditation. Visit the Shrine of Humility, speak the virtue name, and meditate with LUM for three cycles.

Codex pilgrimage. requirement. Codex referral, Isle of the Avatar, when to visit the Codex. Travel to the Codex on the Isle of the Avatar only after the shrine sends you there and receive its counsel.
Shrine of Honesty. method. Honesty completion, return from Codex. Return to the Shrine of Honesty and meditate again to complete the quest and gain attributes.

Shrine of Spirituality. route. Ethereal Void, any moongate, midnight shrine, reach Spirituality from any active gate, Spirituality departure town. Wait beside any active moongate above a buried moonstone. Check your pocket watch and step into the gate at exactly midnight (12:00 AM) to reach the Ethereal Void. You do not need to depart from Skara Brae.

Shrine of Spirituality. method. Spirituality completion, return to Spirituality at midnight. Enter any moongate at exactly midnight again to return to the Shrine of Spirituality, then meditate with OM to complete the quest and gain attributes.

Shrine of Humility. outcome. Humility attribute bonus, Humility attribute increase, Humility stats reward. Return to the Shrine of Humility and meditate again to complete the quest; this shrine grants no attribute bonus.

Shrine pilgrimage. method. shrine Codex cycle, Shrine Codex return loop. 1) Learn the Mantra from NPCs in the virtue's city. 2) Meditate at the shrine using the mantra for three cycles. 3) Visit the Codex on the Isle of the Avatar to receive guidance. 4) Return & Complete by meditating again to gain stats.

Mantras and Words of Power. definition. password types, mantras, Words of Power, mantras versus Words of Power, dungeon words are not shrine mantras. These "passwords" are essential for progressing through the game. Mantras are used at the Shrines of Virtue, while Words of Power unlock the dungeons.
Doom Word of Power. acquisition. VERAMOCOR, Doom password, earn VERAMOCOR from eight shrines. Completing all eight shrine quests grants the Word of Power for Doom: VERAMOCOR.
Faulinei. identity. Faulinei identity, Shadowlord of Falsehood. Faulinei, Shadowlord of Falsehood
Faulinei. acquisition. Faulinei dungeon word, Falsehood Word of Power. Learn FALLAX from Malifora after Malik points you to her.

Shard of Falsehood. route. Falsehood shard route, Faulinei shard, Faulinei shard route, reach the falsehood shard. Descend through Deceit and travel west through the Underworld to the Shard of Falsehood; bring the Carpet and Grapple.

Faulinei. method. Faulinei flame, Flame of Truth, summon Faulinei, call Faulinei out, call out Faulinei, shout Faulinei at flame. At the Lycaeum, stand one tile south of the Flame of Truth and shout FAULINEI.

Faulinei. method. Faulinei shard timing, Shard of Falsehood use, use the falsehood shard on Faulinei, Faulinei stands on flame. Wait one turn, then use the Shard of Falsehood when Faulinei stands on the flame.
Astaroth. identity. Astaroth identity, Shadowlord of Hatred. Astaroth, Shadowlord of Hatred
Astaroth. acquisition. Astaroth dungeon word, Hatred Word of Power. Learn MALUM from Felespar in Yew with DAWN, or follow Rew’s lead in Minoc to Fiona and use DAWN to learn AVIDUS.

Shard of Hatred. route. Hatred shard route, Astaroth shard, Astaroth shard route, reach the hatred shard. Bring mixed AN GRAV spells to dispel magical fields in Wrong or Covetous. Descend into the southwest Underworld labyrinth and recover the Shard of Hatred.

Astaroth. method. Astaroth flame, Flame of Love, summon Astaroth, call Astaroth out, call out Astaroth, shout Astaroth at flame. At Empath Abbey, stand one tile south of the Flame of Love and shout ASTAROTH.

Astaroth. method. Astaroth shard timing, Shard of Hatred use, use the hatred shard on Astaroth, Astaroth stands on flame. Wait one turn, then use the Shard of Hatred when Astaroth stands on the flame.
Nosfentor. identity. Nosfentor identity, Shadowlord of Cowardice. Nosfentor, Shadowlord of Cowardice
Nosfentor. acquisition. Nosfentor dungeon word, Cowardice Word of Power. Ask Kaiko in New Magincia about Hassad, then use Kaiko as a reference with Hassad in Blackthorn’s dungeon to learn IGNAVUS.

Shard of Cowardice. route. Cowardice shard route, Nosfentor shard, Nosfentor shard route, reach the cowardice shard. Descend through Hythloth; use IN POR for mountain rooms and the Magic Carpet over swamp to reach the northeast clearing.

Nosfentor. method. Nosfentor flame, Flame of Courage, summon Nosfentor, call Nosfentor out, call out Nosfentor, shout Nosfentor at flame. At Serpent’s Hold, stand one tile south of the Flame of Courage and shout NOSFENTOR.

Nosfentor. method. Nosfentor shard timing, Shard of Cowardice use, use the cowardice shard on Nosfentor, Nosfentor stands on flame. Wait one turn, then use the Shard of Cowardice when Nosfentor stands on the flame.
Sceptre. requirement. Scepter reclaim, why banish Shadowlords before Sceptre. Banish the Shadowlords first so they cannot reclaim the Sceptre later.
Sceptre. acquisition. Stonegate demon riddle, WELL, Stonegate demon answer. Reach Stonegate with the Grapple, unlock the center door with a Skull Key, and answer the demon’s riddle with WELL.
Sceptre. method. Stonegate fire pits trapdoors, Carpet over Stonegate fire pits. Ride the Magic Carpet over the fire pits and trapdoors, take the Sceptre, and leave before the tower becomes crowded.
Sceptre. effect. Scepter magical fields, Sceptre dispel fields. A reusable way to dispel every magical field.

Crown. requirement. Blackthorn capture permanent, caught while stealing Crown, Blackthorn capture deletes companion, permanent save before Crown. Make a permanent save; capture in Blackthorn’s Castle can permanently erase a companion.

Crown. route. Blackthorn rooftop, reach Blackthorn rooftop, climb to Crown room, route to Crown. Ride the Carpet from the entrance, outrun the guards, and climb through levels two and three to the rooftop.
Crown. acquisition. Crown Skull Key escape, escape after taking Crown, fly off roof with Crown. Use a Skull Key on the center room, take the Crown, board the Carpet, and fly off the roof to escape.
Crown. effect. Crown enemy magic, wear Crown against enemy magic. Protection from enemy magic when the Crown is worn.
Amulet. route. waterfall east of Skara Brae, Lord British's Amulet, route to Amulet, get to Amulet burial ground. Ride the Magic Carpet into the waterfall east of Skara Brae.
Amulet. route. Down Left Down river, Amulet down left down route. At the river junctions travel Down, Left, then Down; circle the lake and continue southeast through swamp and the mountain pass.
Amulet. acquisition. expedition burial ground. Take the Amulet from the burial ground of Lord British’s expedition.

Amulet. method. VAS REL POR return, get back after Amulet, return from Amulet burial ground, no return spell for Amulet. Escape with VAS REL POR, or accept a controlled party death if no return spell remains.
Doom rescue. requirement. royal set Shadowlords. Commit only when every Shadowlord is gone and the full royal set is in the party.
Doom rescue. method. Avatar level 8 recommendation. Reach Avatar level 8 if possible; stock healing, resurrection magic, food, reagents, gems, and a permanent save.

Doom rescue. route. INFAMA, Woolfe Sindar, Dungeon Shame. Carry the Sceptre, Crown, Amulet, and Sandalwood Box. Follow Woolfe’s lead in Trinsic to Sindar for INFAMA, use it to enter Dungeon Shame, and descend to the Underworld.
Amulet. use. Doom entrance, VERAMOCOR entrance. Follow the path to the central Underworld. Use the Amulet to reveal Doom’s entrance and speak VERAMOCOR to enter.
Sceptre and Crown. use. ethereal walls, Crown magic-heavy rooms. Use the Sceptre to dispel ethereal walls and wear the Crown through magic-heavy rooms.
Sandalwood Box. use. Lord British mirror, hidden pit. Find the hidden pit on the final level, step through Lord British’s mirror, and give him the Sandalwood Box.
Orb of the Moons. use. collapsing Doom escape. Use the Orb of the Moons he releases to escape the collapsing dungeon.
Doom rescue. outcome. Lord British returns. Lord British returns and the tyranny collapses.

Secure the Magic Carpet. acquisition. the Magic Carpet, Castle Britannia. Bring a Skull Key from Shenstone’s stump in Minoc, climb to Lord British’s private rooftop room, unlock the magic door, and take the carpet. It crosses shallow water, swamp, brush, and hills; mountains still need the Grapple, and rough sea is dangerous.

Secure the Grapple. acquisition. the Grapple, Empath Abbey, climb small peaks with the hook, Bidney climbing clue. Ask Lord Michael about GRAPPLE. If you want the in-world clue first, ask Bidney in Buccaneer’s Den about climbing; he points you back to the Abbey. The hook opens routes across small peaks.
Free Jaana from Yew. recruitment. Jaana from Yew, Yew. Enter the fireplace behind the living area, descend to the hidden jail, unlock the door, and recruit Jaana.
Build a Resistance Party. recruitment. a Resistance Party, Across Britannia. Recruit Julia at Empath Abbey, Mariah at the Lycaeum, and Gwenno in Britain; use the Party Builder to choose your six.
Stockpile Skull Keys. acquisition. Skull Keys, Minoc. Search Shenstone’s stump at night for five keys.
Raid the Glass Sword Cache. acquisition. the Glass Sword Cache, Serpent’s Spine. Find the hidden valley south of Yew. Ready each sword after finding it to multiply the cache for the party.
Steal the HMS Cape Plans. acquisition. the HMS Cape Plans, East Britanny. Jimmy the locked double doors at The Oaken Oar and search the east room’s drawers for the ship plans.

Claim Jhelom’s Magic Axe. acquisition. Jhelom’s Magic Axe, Jhelom. Use the tower route, push the barrels, and search the concealed stump for a free returning ranged weapon before spending roughly 1,000 gold on additional axes.

Establish a Reagent Run. acquisition. a Reagent Run, Spiritwood & Bloody Plains. Harvest Nightshade at midnight in Spiritwood and Mandrake southeast of Minoc for high-circle travel and scouting magic.
Collect the Sextant & Spyglass. acquisition. the Sextant & Spyglass, Greyhaven & Farthing. Ask David at Greyhaven for the sextant, then visit Seggallion at Farthing for the spyglass.

Recover the Mystic Arms. acquisition. the Mystic Arms, Southeast Underworld. During the Hythloth run for the Shard of Cowardice, continue into the far southeast Underworld and recover Britannia’s hidden Mystic equipment before leaving.
Iolo. explanation. Iolo role, Iolo notes. Bard. A solid starting companion and a capable fighter/bard. His presence is mandatory at the start.
Shamino. explanation. Shamino role, Shamino notes. Fighter. Starts wounded but recovers to be a reliable fighter. His high Dexterity makes him an excellent archer.
Jaana. explanation. Jaana role, Jaana notes. Mage. An essential early recruit. As a mage, her spellcasting ability is invaluable throughout the game.
Mariah. explanation. Mariah role, Mariah notes. Mage. One of the most powerful mages available. Recruiting her requires reaching the Lycaeum, which can be a mid-game objective.
Johne. explanation. Johne role, Johne notes. Mage. The strongest mage in the game, but he is difficult to reach, located on a wrecked ship in the Underworld.
Gwenno. explanation. Gwenno role, Gwenno notes. Bard. A well-rounded bard, Iolo's wife. A good addition to the party if another bard is needed.
Saduj. explanation. Saduj role, Saduj notes. Bard. Do not recruit. He is a spy for Blackthorn and will betray the party. His name is 'Judas' backwards.
Katrina. explanation. Katrina role, Katrina notes. Fighter. Starts at a high level, making her a powerful immediate addition to the party if found later in the game.
An Nox. use. An Nox spell. Circle 1 spell. Cures poison. Reagents: Ginseng, Garlic.
In Por. use. In Por spell. Circle 3 spell. Short-range teleport (Blink). Reagents: Spider Silk, Blood Moss.
An Grav. use. An Grav spell. Circle 4 spell. Dispels magical fields. Reagents: Sulfurous Ash, Black Pearl.
Vas Rel Por. use. Vas Rel Por spell. Circle 8 spell. Gate Travel (teleport to moongates). Reagents: Sulfurous Ash, Black Pearl, Mandrake Root.
In Mani Corp. use. In Mani Corp spell. Circle 8 spell. Resurrects a dead companion. Reagents: Ash, Garlic, Ginseng, Silk, Moss, Mandrake.
Word of Power for Deceit. use. Deceit password, Deceit Word of Power, Honesty dungeon word. Honesty: the dungeon is Deceit. Word of power: FALLAX.
Word of Power for Despise. use. Despise password, Despise Word of Power, Compassion dungeon word. Compassion: the dungeon is Despise. Word of power: VILIS.
Word of Power for Destard. use. Destard password, Destard Word of Power, Valor dungeon word. Valor: the dungeon is Destard. Word of power: INOPIA.
Word of Power for Wrong. use. Wrong password, Wrong Word of Power, Justice dungeon word. Justice: the dungeon is Wrong. Word of power: MALUM.
Word of Power for Covetous. use. Covetous password, Covetous Word of Power, Sacrifice dungeon word. Sacrifice: the dungeon is Covetous. Word of power: AVIDUS.
Word of Power for Shame. use. Shame password, Shame Word of Power, Honor dungeon word. Honor: the dungeon is Shame. Word of power: INFAMA.
Word of Power for Hythloth. use. Hythloth password, Hythloth Word of Power, Spirituality dungeon word. Spirituality: the dungeon is Hythloth. Word of power: IGNAVUS.
Moon phase 1. destination. moongate phase 1. Moon phase 1: Moonglow.
Moon phase 6. destination. moongate phase 6. Moon phase 6: Trinsic.
Moon phase 8. destination. moongate phase 8. Moon phase 8: New Magincia.

Sextant and Spyglass. use. David Greyhaven, Seggallion Farthing. Sextant & Spyglass: Ask David at Greyhaven (lighthouse south of Trinsic) for a free sextant (coords). Seggallion at Farthing grants a spyglass; Zachariah explains it if you're in the Resistance.

Moonstones. use. move moongates, relocate moongates, dig up and rebury moonstones. Moonstones: You can dig up and rebury moonstones to relocate moongates. Consider clustering near Spiritwood/Bloody Plains for reagent runs, and keep one on you as an emergency escape gate.
Brittany villages. use. safe haven Shadowlords. Safe haven: The Brittany villages aren't visited by Shadowlords—use them to lay low when a city is afflicted.
Minoc healer. use. free healing. Free healer: Minoc has a free healer—use while waiting on moon phases.

Grapple. acquisition. Grapple giver, who provides the Grapple, Lord Michael Grappling Hook. Speak with Lord Michael and ask specifically about GRAPPLE.
Take the Grappling Hook he provides and keep it in the active party’s inventory.

Sceptre. acquisition. obtain the Sceptre, Sceptre full acquisition, Scepter acquisition route. Banish the Shadowlords first so they cannot reclaim the Sceptre later.
Reach Stonegate with the Grapple, unlock the center door with a Skull Key, and answer the demon’s riddle with WELL.
Ride the Magic Carpet over the fire pits and trapdoors, take the Sceptre, and leave before the tower becomes crowded.
Crown. location. Crown rooftop location. Blackthorn’s Castle rooftop
Grapple traversal outcome. outcome. Grapple mountain and Underworld routes, Grapple route access. Small mountain peaks and several Underworld routes become traversable.
